page.overview:
What is St. Briss?

The St. Briss was an exploration ship that came from the Briss Kingdom.

The St. Briss was a great, brown ship, rigged with three masts: two bearing twin sails, and a third set with a solitary sheet. Upon the foremost mast, the largest of the sails bore the ship's name, St. Briss., emblazoned boldly on the lower part of the topsail, while the lower, broader canvas displayed the royal emblem of its kingdom: a disc surrounded by a thin circle with four arrowheads emerging on each side. At the prow loomed the figurehead—a reptilian head, with its scaly neck arched forward and its jaws and teeth bared in a silent snarl. The teeth were also darkened with tar in accordance with that nation’s curious custom for their preservation.

The ship became a wreck and was ultimately destroyed by the assault of a giant sea turtle.

The St. Briss set sail from the Briss Kingdom 210 years ago. During the voyage, one of the crew members fell ill and died. Within a few years of setting sail, the ship made it to Skypiea, where the crew managed to acquire a Waver and a map of the nation. However, for unknown reasons, the ship and its crew were eventually condemned to Cloud Drifting, causing everyone on board to perish. Two centuries later, the prison cloud finally dissolved, sending the ship plummeting back to the Blue Sea.
